Hi Aisha —

Appreciate the clear asks. I put together a short suggested sequencing and attached a one-sheet MAP (Crescent_MAP_v3.xlsx) and a joint timeline image (msadpa_joint_timeline_v1.png). High-level recommendations:

1) Parallelize security evidence and DPA negotiation: start DPA redlines in parallel with the security questionnaire so DPA signature can occur as soon as security sign-off lands.
2) MSA to remain the master agreement. Order form should reference the MSA version to avoid duplicate language, but we can hold signature of the first order form until both MSA and DPA are agreed, or use the DPA+Order Form combo if legal prefers staged approach.
3) Milestones that unblock provisioning: security sign-off (ISO/SOC artifacts), purchase order/PO issuance, and billing setup. Plan for a 2-week legal review cycle + 1-week procurement approval if reviewers are responsive.

I flagged three decision points in the MAP:
- Decision A: DPA-first vs MSA-first (we prefer DPA parallel to MSA to avoid delaying security)
- Decision B: Order form signature gating (immediate vs contingent on MSA)
- Decision C: Onboarding window (target provisioning date once PO is raised)

Quick ask: Karthik / Laura — can you glance at the attached redlines (redwood_dpa_redlines.pdf) and call out any legal blockers for the staged-signature approach? If not, we'll propose the staged flow to Crescent: DPA signature + Order Form countersigned conditional on final MSA within 30 days.

Thanks — sending the attachments now.

--
